      AND o.WERKS IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.WERKS
),
a AS (

)

LEFT JOIN a ON a.ESTNR = RIGHT(e.WERKS, 2)
WHERE e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
  AND e.WERKS IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY estate

runs.sql:
SELECT 
    oph_estate_code AS estate_code,
    SUM(bunches_total) AS total_bunches,
    SUM(bunches_ripe) AS ripe_bunches,
    SUM(bunches_unripe) AS unripe_bunches,
    SUM(bunches_overripe) AS overripe_bunches,
    SUM(bunches_underripe) AS underripe_bunches,
    SUM(bunches_rotten) AS rotten_bunches
FROM 
    t_oph
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oph_created_date) = 2025
    AND (oph_is_deleted = 0 OR oph_is_deleted IS NULL)
GROUP BY 
    oph_estate_code
ORDER BY 
    estate_code
